name: Parameter Out Of Scope
hint: Make sure, to only use the parameters of a custom block inside this block.
instruction: Make sure, to only use the parameters of a custom block inside this block.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
define circle (angle)
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (angle) degrees
end

when green flag clicked
show
turn left (angle :: #ff6680) degrees :: #ff0000 //⇦  🐛
circle (15)

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
define circle (angle)
repeat (4)
move (10) steps
turn left (angle) degrees
end

when green flag clicked
show
turn left (15) degrees :: #007000 //⇦  👍
circle (15)
